sections.heading: Beginner Tips and Tricks
sections.body:
For beginners, 'Cat Sorter Puzzle' can seem overwhelming at first, but with practice and patience, it becomes clear that the game's core mechanics are deceptively simple. Here are a few beginner tips and tricks to help you get started:

Start with the easier levels: As you progress through the game, the levels become increasingly difficult, so it's a good idea to start with the easier levels and gradually work your way up. This will give you a chance to get familiar with the game's core mechanics and build up your skills before facing more challenging levels.

Use the power-ups wisely: Power-ups can be a game-changer in 'Cat Sorter Puzzle', but they should be used wisely. Use them to gain an advantage in challenging levels, but avoid using them excessively, as this can lead to a loss of momentum and progress.

Focus on one cat at a time: When faced with a large number of cats, it's easy to get overwhelmed and lose track of the cats. To avoid this, focus on one cat at a time, and make sure to clear the cat before moving on to the next one. This will help you maintain a clear and organized workspace and avoid mistakes.

Practice makes perfect: As with any game, practice makes perfect, so don't be discouraged if you struggle at first. Keep practicing, and you'll eventually develop the skills and strategies needed to succeed in 'Cat Sorter Puzzle'.
